# EdgeConductor

> Connected Asset & IoT Operations Platform for hardware companies.

EdgeConductor is a complete IoT and connected asset platform that enables hardware companies, OEMs, and system integrators to deploy, manage, and operate connected devices at scale — without building backend infrastructure from scratch.

## What EdgeConductor Does

- **Device Registry**: Register, provision, and manage any MQTT-capable device (ESP32, Raspberry Pi, STM32, cellular modems, Linux SBCs, industrial PLCs)
- **Live Telemetry**: Real-time sensor data ingestion, storage, and visualization via drag-and-drop dashboard builder
- **OTA Firmware Updates**: Push firmware updates to individual devices, device groups, or entire fleets with rollback support
- **Device Shadow**: Remote configuration, desired/reported state sync for any connected device
- **Rules Engine**: Threshold-based and schedule-based automation — trigger alerts, control relays, send emails when conditions are met
- **Anomaly Detection**: Automatic detection of sensor anomalies (temperature spikes, signal loss, battery drain)
- **Multi-Tenant RBAC**: Full role-based access control with organization hierarchy — Super Admin → Partner Org → Customer Org → Site → Device
- **White-Label Portals**: Deploy a branded IoT portal at your own domain (portal.yourbrand.com) for your clients
- **Alert Notifications**: Email and Telegram alerts for device offline, rule fires, anomalies
- **Audit Logs**: Complete action history for compliance and debugging

## Who Uses EdgeConductor

- **Hardware startups** building connected products (smart locks, air quality monitors, energy meters)
- **IoT system integrators** delivering solutions to enterprise clients under their own brand
- **OEMs** who manufacture hardware and need a white-label software portal
- **Building automation companies** managing HVAC, climate, and energy across multiple sites
- **Fleet telematics companies** tracking GPS, diagnostics, and remote control of vehicles

## Technical Stack

- **Protocol**: MQTT over TLS (port 8883) — compatible with any MQTT device
- **API**: REST API + WebSocket for real-time data
- **SDKs**: JavaScript/Node.js (`@edgeconductor/sdk`), Python (`edgeconductor`), React components (`@edgeconductor/ec-react`)
- **Hardware**: Works with ESP32, ESP8266, STM32, Raspberry Pi, Quectel/SIMCom cellular modules, any Linux SBC, any device that supports MQTT TLS
- **Infrastructure**: MQTT broker at `services.edgeconductor.com:8883`, REST API at `services.edgeconductor.com`

## Pricing

- **Starter**: Free — 5 devices, 1 org
- **Pro**: ₹4,999/mo ($59/mo) — 50 devices, 5 orgs, rules engine, multi-tenant
- **Business**: ₹14,999/mo ($179/mo) — 250 devices, white-label, custom domain
- **Enterprise**: Custom — unlimited devices, self-hosted option, SLA

## Comparison

EdgeConductor vs AWS IoT Core / Azure IoT Hub: EdgeConductor includes a built-in dashboard, white-label portal, and multi-tenant management — features that require months of custom development on AWS/Azure. EdgeConductor is designed for teams who want to ship connected products, not manage cloud infrastructure.

EdgeConductor vs Blynk / Losant: EdgeConductor supports proper multi-tenant B2B access, RBAC, OEM white-labeling, and enterprise audit logs — capabilities Blynk and Losant lack for serious commercial deployments.
